items.title: Ex-OpenAI researcher fund dumps bitcoin miners, cuts IREN 94% after portfolio slump
items.text: The fund swapped its common stock in Bloom Energy, Nebius and SanDisk for call options, keeping its bet on AI power, computing and memory.

items.title: US senators seek SEC answers on tokenized stock money laundering risks
items.text: Four Democratic senators asked who would be responsible for tokenized shares transferred outside regulated platforms and whether the SEC could freeze or recover those tokens.

items.title: Bitcoin remains penned in near $64,000 even as ETF outflow streak ends
items.text: Bitcoin (BTC) is down a further 1.0% since midnight UTC at around $64,200, with its bounce from the weekend selloff stalled and pressure building on all fronts.

items.title: Solana Foundation takes majority stake in crypto data provider CoinGecko
items.text: The foundation plans Solana-powered trading on CoinGecko's website, GeckoTerminal and app.

items.title: New DeFi-yield generation targets ‘scam-like’ bank accounts that keep all the interest
items.text: Crypto native firms like Animoca Brands are betting AI-based agentic commerce to style every area of finance with the so-called “DeFi mullet”

items.title: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF snaps $2.35B outflow streak amid extreme fear
items.text: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF ended 11 sessions of withdrawals totaling $2.35 billion, but CryptoQuant says one day of inflows is too early to signal a recovery.

items.title: Bitcoin realized loss metric beats June high as open interest eyes 2-year low
items.text: Bitcoin short-term holders’ onchain spending notched the largest proportion of realized losses since February after BTC/USD dropped to $62,000.

items.title: Nvidia's Kress faces earnings test after stock drags Wall Street into the red
items.text: Futures hold the flatline as investors await key results from Nvidia and Disney

items.title: Fed Governor Michael Barr warns AI agents could trigger bank runs in minutes
items.text: In a speech at an AI event in Italy, Barr said automated financial decisions could overwhelm banks and raises concerns about AI systems bypassing security controls.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin and stocks continue slump as Huang signals interest in returning to Nvidia
items.text: The Fed's hawkish rhetoric continued on Tuesday, with St. Louis Fed President Musalem arguing for several rate hikes before next spring. Homebuilder confidence fell to a 14-year low.

items.title: Google says hackers use AI agents to find and exploit software flaws
items.text: Google says attackers are using AI agents to find and exploit software flaws automatically, reducing the time organizations have to apply patches.

items.title: Datenleck: Interne Dokumente belasten die Deutsche Bank
items.text: Die Schatten der Vergangenheit holen die Deutsche Bank erneut ein. Informationen aus einem Datenleck offenbaren fragwürdige Geschäftspraktiken und mutmaßliche Probleme bei den Kontrollen beim größten deutschen Geldhaus.

items.title: US judge clears brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV case after mistrial
items.text: Judge Jessica Clarke said the transactions did not involve false promises, but the ruling did not determine whether the brothers’ conduct was ethical or violated other laws.

items.title: Goldman Sachs reports $1.22B in Ether ETFs as ETHA share count jumps
items.text: Goldman Sachs increased its Ether ETF shares in Q3, bringing its reported holdings to $1.22 billion, while reshuffling its Bitcoin ETF positions.

items.title: US-Regierung verhängt neue Exportbeschränkungen für KI-Chips
items.text: Die US-Regierung verschärft ihre Ausfuhrregeln für hochmoderne KI-Chips und will damit nach dem Nvidia-Skandal Schlupflöcher nach China schließen. Die Tech-Aktien in den USA sackten nach der Bekanntgabe ab.

items.title: Tag der Wohnungswirtschaft: Bauen verteuert sich weiter - trotz aller Versprechen
items.text: Trotz Beteuerungen der Politik: Bauen wird in Deutschland immer teurer. Neben globalen Einflüssen wie etwa steigende Energiepreise seien viele Probleme aber hausgemacht, heißt es aus der Branche. Von Axel John.

items.title: U.S. agencies say they initiated investigation into Nvidia partner Megaspeed in 2024
items.text: The Commerce and Justice departments said in a joint statement that U.S. investigations into Megaspeed began in 2024.

items.title: Ex-Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to $125K Hyperliquid trading scheme
items.text: The former Robinhood engineer used confidential information about upcoming Robinhood token listings to trade on Hyperliquid.

items.title: Nach Huang-Affäre: Bald alles neu in der KI-Chipindustrie?
items.text: Konkurrenten wie AMD oder Qualcomm reiben sich nach dem Abgang von Huang als CEO bei Nvidia schon die Hände. Was ist dran am möglichen Umbruch der Chip-Branche - und wie viel hat er tatsächlich mit dem Abtritt Huangs zu tun? Von R. Spiegelhauer.

items.title: Jim Cramer says Nvidia’s leadership shake-up won’t derail the AI trade
items.text: CNBC's Jim Cramer pushed back against fears that Nvidia's leadership shake-up could unravel the AI boom.

items.title: Aschenbrenner’s Situational Awareness made AI bets again before October rout
items.text: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund, which almost collapsed over the summer, bought AI stocks before shares began tumbling.

items.title: JPMorgan Chase says temporary software bug is affecting consumer banking
items.text: CNBC's Eamon Javers reported there was no indication of bad actors involved and likewise no indication that a bug was impacting multiple banks at the same time.

items.title: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracts in third-quarter as elevated energy costs bite
items.text: Energy subsidies for households had reportedly expired in September, exposing the economy to the higher energy prices brought about by the Iran war.
